PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Cloud-saved player profile, progression, unlocked arsenal, combat telemetry, custom avatar, and achievements.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

callsign.description: In-game username / operator callsign (unique across all players).

callsignLocked.description: True once unique callsign has been claimed, preventing any future changes.

avatarDataUrl.description: Custom uploaded compressed avatar DataURL or profile photo URL.

bombsPlanted.description: Total C4 charges armed and planted.

unlockedAchievements.description: Array of unlocked tactical achievement IDs.

economyVersion.description: Economy schema version for balance resets.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when profile was last synced.

UsernameRegistry.title: UsernameRegistry
UsernameRegistry.description: Ensures unique operator callsigns globally across all players.

uid.description: The UID of the player who owns this callsign.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the callsign was claimed.

MultiplayerRoom.title: MultiplayerRoom
MultiplayerRoom.description: Real-time 5v5 PvP room state, round score, C4 state, and active human operator telemetry.

isPrivate.description: True if room is private (joinable only by code), false if open to matchmaking.

queueType.description: Queue mode for matchmaking: CASUAL or RANKED.

averageMmr.description: Target/average Skill Rating (MMR) of the room for Ranked matchmaking.

players.description: Map of connected human players keyed by UID.

lastHitEvent.description: Latest combat hit or elimination event broadcast in the room.

updatedAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of last room state update.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when room was created.

SocialInbox.title: SocialInbox
SocialInbox.description: Stores a player's friends list, incoming friend requests, and real-time 5v5 match invitations.

friends.description: Map of confirmed friends keyed by friend UID.

requests.description: Map of incoming friend requests keyed by sender UID.

invites.description: Map of active 5v5 room invites keyed by sender UID.

updatedAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of last social update.

DirectChat.title: DirectChat
DirectChat.description: Real-time direct chat thread between two friends.

chatId.description: Sorted pair of UIDs joined by underscore.

messages.description: Recent direct messages between the two operators.

/players/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated player's persistent profile, progression, unlocked weapons, avatar, and achievements.

/usernames/{usernameLower}.description: Global unique registry mapping lowercase callsign to owning player UID.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Real-time 5v5 online multiplayer rooms for matchmaking and private code lobbies.

/social_inboxes/{userId}.description: Real-time social inbox for friends list, friend requests, and match invites.

/direct_chats/{chatId}.description: Real-time direct messages between two friends.
